outputs.explanation: Panel A top graph is a bar chart of mean cell death (%) with error bars, stated to be 'Mean±s.d. of three independent experiments'. This is an averaged measure but the underlying individual data points (the three replicate values per condition) are not overlaid on the bars, so variability/robustness of the small n cannot be assessed.

Panel B top graph is a bar chart of mean cell death (%) with error bars, analogous to panel A (repeated experiment format), yet no individual data points are shown for the replicates behind each bar/error bar.

Panel C is a bar chart of mean cell death (%) at three time points with error bars, explicitly described as 'Mean±s.d. of three experiments'. The individual replicate values are not plotted alongside the bars.
Panel D top graph is a bar chart of cell death (%) with visible error bars indicating averaged data across replicates, but the individual data points underlying each bar are not shown.
